title: Linear PCPP verifier system
statement: For each positive natural number $m$, there is a Boolean proof-carrying property-testing system whose input has length $2m$, whose proof has length $2m+1$, and whose verifier makes three nonadaptive query slots. Its seed is uniform over the linear check seed space. For a Boolean seed, it queries the corresponding proof prefix position in the first slot and makes no other queries. For a seed $(i,	ext{false})$, it queries the two input positions in the two blocks at index $i$, then the corresponding proof product position. For a seed $(i,	ext{true})$, it queries the proof prefix positions corresponding to $i$ and $i+1$ and the proof product position at $i$. It accepts by the linear transcript acceptance rule.
caveat: The designated proof positions are expressed using index functions whose definitions were not supplied, so their exact coordinate numbering cannot be given.
